name: ultra.proof
description: ULTRA Proof studio: is this evidence evidence? Chain integrity, digests and planted-failure presence are checked by code; Jev only judges whether a check could pass while the thing it names is false.

done_test_is_vacuous.instructions: This done-test can go green while the outcome it names is false (it checks existence, a string, or its own narration).

claim_atomic.instructions: This claim states one verifiable thing rather than several bundled together.

evidence_is_command_output.instructions: This evidence is a command result, file digest, or artifact bytes rather than a narrative about them.

rules.reason: vacuous done-test: a gate that cannot go red is theater
compound claim cannot be verified or falsified as written: split it
narrative evidence: the verdict is unsure, not passed

notes.done_test_is_vacuous: doc signal p.done_test_is_vacuous. Motivation: a 300-checkpoint report whose runner contained zero assertions and hardcoded full_scenario_executed:false (projects/transformfit-qa.md).
notes.evidence_is_command_output: doc signal p.evidence_is_command_output; SLSA/in-toto bind claims to digests, not to prose.
